setup.name: setup-01-python
setup.cmd: python -c "import urllib.request as u; B='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/munimtechnologies/interface-heat-transport/main/'; [u.urlretrieve(B + p, '/work/' + p) for p in ('run_tbc.py', 'tbc_transport.py', 'tbc_phonons.py', 'test_tbc_transport.py')]"

run_steps.name: run-01-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python -m py_compile run_tbc_safe.py test_run_tbc_safe.py run_tbc.py tbc_transport.py tbc_phonons.py test_tbc_transport.py && grep -h 'VERSION = ' *.py | tee /out/versions.txt && pip list 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E 'torch|mace|orb|phonopy|ase|numpy' | tee -a /out/versions.txt; sha256sum *.py | tee /out/sha256.txt

run_steps.name: run-02-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python -m unittest -v test_run_tbc_safe test_tbc_transport > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-03-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 python run_tbc_safe.py --out /out --models mace-mpa-0,orb-v3 --budget-min 150 > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -v 'Downloading:' /out/run.txt | tail -n 80; exit $rc
